scripts.check:cloudflare: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs'); const txt=fs.readFileSync('wrangler.jsonc','utf8'); if(/\"id\":\s*\"0{32}\"/.test(txt)||/\"preview_id\":\s*\"1{32}\"/.test(txt)){console.error('Update placeholder KV namespace IDs in wrangler.jsonc before deploy.'); process.exit(1)}"
scripts.deploy: npm run check:cloudflare && opennextjs-cloudflare build && opennextjs-cloudflare deploy
